settings.timezone_note: All dates are local-date ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD). No times, no timezones — a card due 'today' is due all day.

cards.front: In SM-2, what happens to the interval when you grade a card below 3?
cards.back: It resets to 1 day and the repetition count goes to 0 (relearning). The ease factor is left alone.

cards.front: PostgreSQL listens on port {{5432}} by default.
